conversation.text:
Police: Is this the subdistrict office?
Respondent: Yes, Captain. Work must be tough, right?
Respondent: I am the director of Rongzhou Subdistrict Office.
Respondent: Here’s the situation: for this year’s new student registration, there are four children in our subdistrict who have not registered.
Respondent: I’m calling mainly to ask for your help.
Respondent: I’ve already spoken with the parents of these four children on the phone. Some said they went abroad for travel, and some said they were too busy with work.
Respondent: The elementary school opening ceremony hasn’t started yet, so I have reported to my superiors that there is no problem.
Respondent: Although it has been confirmed, the process still needs to be followed.
Respondent: The official letter requesting assistance is currently under approval. It will state that the Education Bureau and the local police station have both sent personnel for home visits... There’s no problem, right?
Respondent: I’m giving you special consideration. You understand what I mean, right? The dispatch subsidy provided by our side seems to be quite generous.
Respondent: After you receive the official letter, just send me the list of your relevant staff members and their bank account numbers. We will handle the rest here.
